Mark tag with no highlight style strips the mark

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"highlight_style\":\"None\"}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Text with <mark>plain</mark> content.</p>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
